page: /de/events/ + /de/events/<slug>/ (EventsView.astro block de; EventDetailView.astro block de; TEXT_DE in src/data/events.ts; eventsTable caption in tables.ts)
part: Batch 3 of 5 — event cards 5–8: Palm Village · Al-Uqair Winter · Al-Wafrah Winter · Horse Racing Season

ev.palm-village.name.context: Event name: card H2 (link), H1 of its single-event page, first cell of its table row, breadcrumb, browser-tab title.

ev.palm-village.place.context: Venue line on the card after «Ort»/place label; also the table’s 2nd cell and a fact row on the event page. Venue names must match the published German names of the venue attractions (see context: venue_attractions_published).

ev.palm-village.season.context: Season badge on the card photo; also «season · time» in the table’s 3rd cell. Very short; capitalised as a standalone badge.

ev.palm-village.time.context: Approximate timing next to a calendar icon on the card (after the season in the table cell «season · time»). Approximate wording must stay approximate — never turn «Around»/«تقريباً» into a firm date.

ev.palm-village.span.context: Approximate duration, shown on the card next to the timing and as «Ungefähre Dauer»-row on the event page. Short.

ev.palm-village.org.en: National Center for Palms and Dates
ev.palm-village.org.context: Organising bodies (dd after the «Organisers» label). Official bodies by their termbase names; a body not in the termbase must be sourced in stage 4 (URL) or kept descriptive.
